paper_title: HeLIOS: The Superfluid Helium Ultralight Dark Matter Detector
notes: Projected (not measured) sensitivity for prototype HeLIOS superfluid helium optomechanical detector after 1 hr integration. Paper presents BOTH scalar (d_me, ScalarElectron) and vector (g_B-L, VectorBL) UDM projections in Fig. 1. Chose VectorBL per hint. Mass range ~1-10 peV (Compton freq ~0.3-10 kHz) for the odd modes coupling to vector UDM. Data points are approximate estimates read from the discrete mode sensitivities in the exclusion plot Fig. 1 (right); precise numerical values are not tabulated. Prototype could not observe thermal motion; the projections assume quantum/thermal-limited readout. Values are rough estimates from the plot axes (g_B-L axis spans 1e-26 to 1e-16). Low confidence due to reliance on reading discrete-mode sensitivity islands from a plot rather than tabulated values. | [VISION GATE A] is_projection=true but the vision notes say the traced curve is existing constraint — not the paper's own projected curve ; [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('combined Eot-Wash and LIGO/Virgo bounds') rather than the paper's own single curve
